Foley Sound Design is a specialized course that teaches students how to create and record custom sound effects for films, television, animation, games, and digital media. The course covers the fundamentals of sound recording, Foley techniques, sound editing, synchronization, ambience creation, and audio mixing. Students learn how to recreate everyday sounds such as footsteps, clothing movement, object handling, and environmental effects to enhance storytelling and realism. Through practical studio projects, learners develop professional audio production skills and creative sound design techniques. This course prepares students for careers in film, broadcasting, gaming, animation, and multimedia production.

Graphic Design is a creative course that teaches students how to communicate ideas through visual de...

Graphic Design is a creative course that teaches students how to communicate ideas through visual design. The course covers design principles, color theory, typography, layout design, branding, logo creation, social media creatives, print media, and digital marketing materials. Students learn to create posters, brochures, banners, advertisements, packaging designs, and professional presentations. The program focuses on creativity, visual storytelling, image editing, and modern design trends through practical projects and portfolio development. By completing this course, students gain the skills required for careers in advertising agencies, design studios, media companies, marketing departments, and freelance graphic design.

3D Animation is a creative course that teaches students how to design, model, animate, and render re...

3D Animation is a creative course that teaches students how to design, model, animate, and render realistic characters, objects, and environments. The course covers the complete animation pipeline, including concept development, 3D modeling, texturing, lighting, rigging, character animation, visual effects, and rendering techniques. Students learn industry-standard workflows and develop practical skills through hands-on projects. The program also focuses on storytelling, motion principles, camera techniques, and portfolio development. Upon completion, students can pursue careers in animation studios, gaming companies, film production, advertising, architectural visualization, and digital media industries with strong creative and technical expertise.

film making

Film Making is a comprehensive course that introduces students to the art and process of creating professional films and videos. The course covers story development, scriptwriting, pre-production planning, cinematography, camera techniques, lighting, sound recording, directing, editing, and post-production. Students learn how to create engaging visual content, manage film projects, and work with production teams effectively. Practical assignments help develop creative and technical skills required in the media industry. The program also focuses on storytelling, shot composition, visual aesthetics, and portfolio development. Graduates can pursue careers in film production, television, digital media, advertising, and content creation.

Architected solutions are thoughtfully designed to align technology, business goals, and user needs. A well-architected system emphasizes scalability, reliability, security, and performance while maintaining flexibility for future growth. It involves careful planning of infrastructure, applications, data flow, and integrations to ensure seamless operation across environments. Effective architecture reduces complexity, minimizes risks, and supports efficient resource utilization. By following best practices and industry standards, architected frameworks enable organizations to deliver consistent experiences, accelerate innovation, and adapt to changing demands. Strong architecture serves as the foundation for sustainable development, operational excellence, and long-term business success.

The VFX (Visual Effects) course is designed to train students in creating stunning visual effects fo...

The VFX (Visual Effects) course is designed to train students in creating stunning visual effects for films, television, advertisements, web series, and digital media. Students learn compositing, rotoscoping, green screen keying, match moving, motion tracking, matte painting, particle effects, color correction, and 3D integration. The course combines creative and technical skills using industry-standard software and production workflows. Through practical projects and real-world assignments, students gain hands-on experience in creating professional visual effects and building a strong portfolio. Career opportunities include VFX Artist, Compositor, Rotoscopy Artist, Matchmove Artist, Motion Graphics Artist, and FX Artist.

The 2D Animation course is designed to help students develop artistic and storytelling skills for th...

The 2D Animation course is designed to help students develop artistic and storytelling skills for the animation industry. Students learn character design, storyboarding, background creation, digital drawing, motion principles, lip-sync animation, and visual storytelling techniques. The course covers traditional and digital animation workflows using industry-standard software. Through hands-on projects, students create animated characters, short films, advertisements, and digital content while building a professional portfolio. The program emphasizes creativity, timing, movement, and production techniques required in modern animation. Career opportunities include 2D Animator, Character Designer, Storyboard Artist, Motion Graphics Artist, and Multimedia Artist.

The Game Design course teaches students how to create engaging and interactive games for mobile, PC,...

The Game Design course teaches students how to create engaging and interactive games for mobile, PC, console, and online platforms. Students learn game concepts, level design, character creation, storytelling, game mechanics, UI/UX design, and asset development. The course covers 2D and 3D game design using industry-standard tools and game engines. Through practical projects, students gain experience in designing characters, environments, gameplay systems, and immersive user experiences. Portfolio development and industry-based assignments help students prepare for careers as Game Designers, Level Designers, Game Artists, UI/UX Designers, and Interactive Media Professionals in the gaming industry.

The 3D Animation course is designed to develop creative and technical skills required for the animation industry. Students learn character modeling, texturing, rigging, lighting, rendering, and animation using industry-standard software. The course covers character design, environment creation, visual storytelling, camera techniques, and special effects. Through practical projects and hands-on training, students build a professional portfolio and gain experience in creating animated films, games, advertisements, and digital content. This program prepares students for careers as 3D Animators, Modelers, Rigging Artists, Lighting Artists, and Visual Effects Artists in the media and entertainment industry.

Participants work on real-world projects in areas such as Animation, VFX, Graphic Design, Video Editing, Filmmaking, Game Design, and Digital Media within a limited time frame of 120 hours. The competition encourages teamwork, problem-solving, and professional project execution while providing valuable industry experience. It is a platform for students and creative professionals to showcase their talent, build impressive portfolios, gain recognition, and compete with passionate creators. Winners receive certificates, awards, and opportunities for career growth and exposure.
